messages:
Leah (Product): ACME just confirmed they want a private-tenant pilot with customer HSM + a demo that requires a 4k burst prewarm on May 20. Need cross-team owners and launch criteria by EOD Fri.
Tomas (Eng): Clarify: is the demo single 4k QPS spike for ~5 mins, or sustained? That changes prewarm strategy.
Leah (Product): They said 4k for a 10-minute demo window, then drop to steady ~600 rps.
Ivy (Runtime): Runtime implications: short high spike -> we can do aggressive prewarm (warm many workers with KV cache) but memory pressure and GPU allocation could be huge. I'll put together two profiles: aggressive prewarm vs staged warm.
Noah (Infra): Infra needs the HSM vendor name + their API endpoints, and whether we must terminate inside customer VPC. Also need to know if dedicated GPUs are mandatory. Provisioning timeline: reserved pool (2-3 weeks), burst-on-demand (2-3 days but higher cost).
Esha (Security): Security checklist: HSM attestation, network ACLs, IAM roles mapped, audit log export endpoint, SLA for key revocation. If the HSM is in-customer, we need a Data Processing Agreement amendment.
Tomas (Eng): Draft acceptance criteria proposal:
- HSM connectivity smoke: successful attestation + test encrypt/decrypt cycle
- Performance: steady P50 < 100ms, P95 < 350ms; during demo spike P95 < 700ms
- Quality: regression eval run vs customer prompt set within +/-2% metric
- Deployment: canary plan + rollback runbook
- Compliance: signed DPA addendum and HSM attestation
Thoughts?
Leah (Product): Add a cost cap for the demo (customer or our absorb?). ACME expects us not to bill surprises; product will negotiate but we need a number to work against.
Ivy (Runtime): I'll deliver a perf matrix by Tue with these knobs: quantization (4/8-bit), KV cache sizes, async batch sizing. Example command I'm planning to run:
```bash
python run_perf_harness.py --model rwd-v2 --quant 4bit --seq 2048 --burst 4000 --out perf_acme.csv
```
Noah (Infra): I'll open INF ticket and attach a provisioning checklist. Need CIDR ranges + whether the customer's HSM requires private peering or public egress. Leah, can you get that?
Leah (Product): Will ask ACME today and post to the infra ticket. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Esha (Security): Fallback policy: we only allow fallback to hosted KMS if the customer signs a waiver that they accept hosted KMS for the demo. Otherwise we must validate their HSM in staging for 72 hours before demo. Leah, can ACME accept a waiver?
Leah (Product): I'll confirm. My sense is they'd be reluctant but might accept for non-sensitive keys.
Tomas (Eng): Operational sequence suggestion: 1) Security sign-off & DPA -> 2) Infra provisioning + network tests -> 3) Runtime perf + quant smoke -> 4) Reserve prewarm capacity -> 5) Canary -> 6) Demo. Owners?
Ivy (Runtime): I'll own step 3 and the perf harness.
Noah (Infra): I'll own step 2 and 4 (with infra lead for capacity).
Esha (Security): I'll own step 1.
Tomas (Eng): I'll own the canary and rollback playbook.
deploy-bot: canary created: canary/privpilot/acme-1776543210 by Tomas. Strategy: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 30-min windows. Details in /deploys.
Leah (Product): Two API-level asks: 1) explicit error codes when KMS unavailable, with clear customer-facing message; 2) metrics emitted for HSM failover rate. Need both for SRE + customer success.
Ivy (Runtime): We'll add a metric hsm.failover.count and emit structured error code KMS-503 when network fails.
Noah (Infra): For prewarm cost comparison, I'll quantify delta: reserved pool monthly vs one-off burst allocation. Will post numbers in ticket by Fri.
Esha (Security): Also a quick privacy note: ensure logs scrub key material and sensitive prompt/context per retention policy. We'll need an audit log retention plan.
Tomas (Eng): If customer refuses fallback and we must validate 72h in staging, timeline slips. We should surface two release dates to sales: optimistic (waiver accepted) and conservative (+7 days if no waiver).
Leah (Product): Good call. I'll sync with sales and ACME. Final action items recap: Leah -> confirm HSM vendor, CIDRs, waiver; Noah -> infra ticket + capacity/cost delta; Ivy -> perf matrix + failure-mode runs; Esha -> security checklist + DPA path; Tomas -> canary + rollback playbook. Checkpoint Friday 9am PT.
Leah (Product): Thanks team — I'll ping after ACME responds. :umbrella:
